patch_description: Adapt which move structures receive LP calls using their confirmed improvement rates. Classify proposals by the number of changed links (two-switch, three-link rotation, or larger move), then maintain a smoothed success estimate for each class. Batch selection gives stronger representation to move classes that have actually improved their parent, while retaining a floor for every class so under-sampled operators continue to be explored. This makes the expensive LP budget respond to observed network-quality improvements rather than relying on a fixed mix of proposals.
